comments.note: stale-state guard: applyProjectReset() re-reads each WP under lock before writing and skips WPs whose status changed since the diagnosis. This prevents silent data corruption during concurrent resets.
blocked_by field is correctly cleared (delete operator) when a BLOCKED WP is reset to IN_PROGRESS. This prevents stale blocker data from persisting after reset.

summary: Code review PASS. applyProjectReset() is clean, correct, and consistent with all acceptance criteria. Full findings follow.

ARCHITECTURE: Pure analysis function (analyzeProjectForReset) correctly separated from mutating apply function (applyProjectReset). The separation enables easy unit testing of the analysis path without I/O.
LOCK DISCIPLINE: All writes — WP files, root index, project comment — are inside a single withLock() scope. No writes are performed outside the lock.

STALE-STATE GUARD: WP re-read under lock, status compared to diagnosis snapshot. Diverged WPs log a stderr warning and are skipped, preventing silent data corruption. Confirmed no writes to process.stdout (STDIO constraint satisfied).

RESET ACTION: wp.status = 'IN_PROGRESS', assigned_to set from wpDiag.target_assigned_to, status_changed_at updated. blocked_by cleared via delete operator (avoids undefined property on typed object — correct idiom).

CRITERIA RESET: reset_criteria defaults to true (decision.reset_criteria !== false). When true, all criterion.met flags are set false. When false, pre-existing met values are preserved. Both variants tested and verified.
CANCEL ACTION: wp.status = 'CANCELLED', wpSummary updated in root index. Pipelines array untouched in both reset and cancel paths — confirmed in source.
ROOT INDEX: pending_work_packages recomputed from non-terminal statuses. status forced to IN_PROGRESS, synthesis_generated = false, auto_handoff_depth = 0, last_updated patched.

AUDIT COMMENT: project_comments.push with type 'admin_action', priority 'high', agent 'GUI'. Comment note lists Reset/Cancelled/Skipped IDs. Return value summary is independent of comment note — both present.
TESTS: 27/27 pass (project-reset.test.ts: 14 units, api-reset.test.ts: 13 integration). tsc --noEmit clean (0 errors). No regressions in full suite (1040/1040).

comments.note: The delete (wp as Record<string, unknown>).blocked_by idiom to clear the optional field is correct and avoids leaving undefined properties that could fail JSON schema validation downstream.

BLOCKED WPs are classified as 'healthy' in the analysis with suggested_action 'skip'. This is the appropriate conservative default — users should evaluate BLOCKED WPs manually before deciding to reset them.
The IN_PROGRESS + all-stages-passed edge case is handled with a distinct 'may need manual completion' reason and skip suggestion, avoiding an incorrect reset loop.
